modelOverview: Launched at Baselworld 2019, the ref. 5172G is Patek Philippe's flagship hand-wound chronograph, replacing the long-running ref. 5170 in the Complications collection. It houses the manufacture's own Calibre CH 29-535 PS, the first in-house chronograph movement Patek Philippe introduced in 2009, inside a larger, bolder 41mm white gold case with vintage-inspired three-tier lugs and guilloched pushers.

5172G-001.movement: Manual-wind · Patek Philippe Calibre CH 29-535 PS · 33 jewels · 4Hz (28,800 vph) · ~65h power reserve
5172G-001.materials: 18k white gold case on a blue calfskin strap with nubuck finish and contrasting cream stitching, white gold fold-over (deployant) buckle
5172G-001.dial: Blue varnished dial with applied white gold Arabic numerals and white gold luminescent syringe-shaped hands, tachymeter scale on the outer rim, 30-minute counter at 3 o'clock, small seconds at 9 o'clock and 60-second chronograph counter
5172G-001.description: The 5172G-001 is Patek Philippe's current in-house hand-wound chronograph, built around the manufacture's own Calibre CH 29-535 PS column-wheel movement with horizontal clutch. It succeeded the ref. 5170 as the brand's flagship dress chronograph, growing to a bolder 41mm white gold case with a blue varnished dial and white gold Arabic numerals and hands. Every piece we offer is professionally sourced and authenticated.

variants.White Gold – Silver: The 5172G-001 in its standard 18k white gold execution, paired with the blue varnished dial and its contrasting white gold applied Arabic numerals, syringe-shaped hands and tachymeter scale, on a blue calfskin strap with white gold fold-over buckle.
